scope: Suggestions only; not applied by this translation map.

replacements.originalEnglish: The burning of coal is responsible for more than 40% of Australia's greenhouse gas emissions.
replacements.reason: 无日期的特定国家排放百分比，数据具有时效性，未在本批事实核实。

suggestedExample.en: The new equipment reduces harmful emissions.
suggestedExample.zh: 新设备减少了有害排放。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Japan entered into an alliance with France just before the war.
replacements.reason: 未指明哪场战争或哪项协定，历史关系缺乏上下文，建议普通同盟语境。

suggestedExample.en: The two organizations formed an alliance to protect the forest.
suggestedExample.zh: 这两个组织结成联盟，以保护森林。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Latin Americans know very little about the history of the indigenous peoples who used to live here several centuries ago.
replacements.reason: 对拉丁美洲人历史知识的笼统概括，缺乏可核实限定；以中性原住民语境替代。

suggestedExample.en: The museum displays artwork by indigenous artists.
suggestedExample.zh: 博物馆展示原住民艺术家的作品。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Tom was sitting at the bar drinking a Bloody Mary.
replacements.reason: Bloody Mary 是鸡尾酒专名，不体现主词 bloody 的常用染血/血腥形容词义。

suggestedExample.en: She put the bloody bandage into a bag.
suggestedExample.zh: 她把染血的绷带放进袋子。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: The human skull consists of 23 bones.
replacements.reason: 头骨骨块数没有说明计数口径，不在译文中暗改数字；建议不含数量断言的语境。

suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Chad has the world's third-highest maternal mortality rate.
replacements.reason: 未标注年份的国家孕产妇死亡率排名具有时效性，未在本批核实。

suggestedExample.en: The report compares mortality rates in several regions.
suggestedExample.zh: 这份报告比较了几个地区的死亡率。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Wolves are predators, but they don't eat each other.
replacements.reason: 包含“狼不会相互吞食”的绝对化生物行为断言，不在译文中改写；建议无绝对断言的语境。

suggestedExample.en: The wolf is a skilled predator.
suggestedExample.zh: 狼是善于捕猎的捕食动物。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v16 · CC0
